The Tampa Bay Rays averaged 9,713 fans a game in 2025, a decrease of 41.2% from the season before, though expected attendance based on prior crowds, win rate, and market size was unavailable because they played in a temporary ballpark[1]. This drop coincided with major stadium changes: Hurricane Milton heavily damaged Tropicana Field, rendering it unusable for the entire 2025 season[2]. Consequently, the Rays played their 2025 home games at George M. Steinbrenner Field in Tampa[2]. While total attendance fell, the smaller venue meant the Rays drew 88.1% of capacity in 2025, which was 22.1 percentage points above their 2024 mark of 66.0% of capacity[3]. On the field, the team spent most of the season above .500 before finishing with a losing record[2].

args.task: Compare Tampa Bay Rays attendance, expected attendance, and fill rates between the 2024 and 2025 seasons, including the difference.

tool_calls.result:
- In 2024, the Tampa Bay Rays averaged 16,515 fans {Q2.r1.avg_attendance} per home game (season official average), with an official home total of 1,337,739 {Q2.r1.official_home_total} across 81 home games, finishing with an 80-82 record (table: team_season_model).
- In 2025, the Tampa Bay Rays averaged 9,713 fans {Q2.r2.avg_attendance} per home game, with an official home total of 786,750 {Q2.r2.official_home_total} across 81 home games, finishing with a 77-85 record (table: team_season_model).
- Comparing attendance between the two seasons, the average attendance decreased by 41.2% {Q2.r2.yoy_change_pct} (-6,802 fans per game) from 2024 to 2025 (table: team_season_model).
- Expected average attendance was 18,343.18 {Q2.r1.expected_avg_attendance} in 2024 (with a residual percentage of -10.0% {Q2.r1.residual_pct}), whereas expected attendance and residual percentage were unavailable for 2025 because the Rays played at Steinbrenner Field, a temporary park (table: team_season_model).
- The average fill rate for Rays home games was 65.99% {Q3.r1.avg_fill_pct} across 81 games in 2024 and 88.08% {Q3.r2.avg_fill_pct} across 81 games in 2025, representing an increase of 22.09 percentage points in fill rate (tables: team_season_model, games_clean).
